integrity: Proof is given for all n >= 1 and all coordinate-transitive groups. Standalone verification uses exact finite orbit enumeration and binary-field boundary ranks only; finite tests do not imply the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Inclusive Hamming scale two only; coordinate-transitive subgroups of S_n only, not affine cube symmetries, mixed actions, arbitrary scales, quotient homotopy types, or equivariant attaching maps. Computational verification tests selected transitive groups through dimension eight, not every group. Independent validation not yet performed.
title: Geometric fixed-point phase change for transitive coordinate groups on binary-cube Rips complexes
